svg.title: Mandala Rift — Ember Rite level blueprint
svg.desc: Cross the raised Sluice to keep both sites in reach, or commit to a sheltered bank or folded doorway and give away the timing of your arrival. North is up. Two scaled site details and a floor elevation section accompany the plan.
svg.text: Cross the raised Sluice to keep both sites in reach, or commit to a sheltered
bank or folded doorway and give away the timing of your arrival.
Profile connects room centres. Vertical scale exaggerated. Landings are flat in the 3D model.
